_meta.purpose: Externalised, citable parameters for the deterministic stimulation-protocol module (stim_protocol.py). Edit values here; never hard-code clinical thresholds in code.

units.amh: ng/mL (converted internally to pmol/L via amh_pmol_per_ng_ml)
units.dose: IU/day (conventional gonadotrophin) unless follitropin_delta branch is used

_meta.disclaimer: Decision support only. The treating physician sets the final dose and protocol. Values encode published anchors; verify against your local protocol and current SmPCs.

phenotype_thresholds._source: ORT-based stratification consistent with Bologna/POSEIDON criteria and AMH-stratified dose-response trials (Arce et al.; ESHRE OS guideline 2025).

ohss_thresholds._source: ASRM OHSS prevention guideline 2023 (Fertil Steril 2024;121:230-45): high AMH, PCOS and anticipated high yield drive OHSS risk; antagonist preferred when OHSS concern.

target_yield._source: LBR plateaus around the mid-teens of oocytes while OHSS risk keeps rising; supports a bounded target rather than 'maximise'. Confirm anchor (e.g. Sunkara et al., Hum Reprod 2011) against your registry.

dose_bands_iu._source: ESHRE OS guideline 2025: conventional daily FSH 150-225 IU. ORT-based dosing reduces moderate/severe OHSS. In poor responders higher doses do NOT improve live birth (inverse FSH-dose/LBR relationship, JARG 2021); hence an explicit ceiling, not an open escalation.

dose_modifiers._source: Weak/mixed evidence; applied as small bounded nudges, flagged in output as low-confidence.

bmi.note: modest upward nudge for high BMI; evidence weak

follitropin_delta._VERIFY: DISABLED by default. The exact AMH->ug/kg steps below are placeholders. Confirm every value against the CURRENT Rekovelle (follitropin delta) SmPC for your market BEFORE enabling for any clinical use.
